page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor built on the x86_64 architecture, providing 16 physical cores and 32 virtual CPUs via simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation stands at 128.0 GB, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. The processor features 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a 35 MB shared L3 cache, alongside support for AVX, AVX-512, and AES instruction sets. This configuration contains no local storage volumes, relying completely on external network-attached block storage, provides no bundled public IPv4 addresses, and includes no dedicated GPU accelerators. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 6 Gbps.

Benchmark results highlight an architectural profile characterized by modest single-threaded throughput balanced by stable multithreaded capacity. In CPU testing, single-core scores across Geekbench (945.0) and stress-ng (1108.19) place in the lower tier, mirrored by low single-threaded gzip compression performance. However, scaling across all 32 vCPUs brings multi-core results into median ranges, demonstrated by a Geekbench multi-core score of 8272.0, a PassMark CPU score of 23181.17, and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 109.42 GB/sec. Memory subsystems register median capabilities with uncached read and write bandwidths of 98.48 GB/sec and 49.01 GB/sec, respectively.

The compute profile reflects older Intel Xeon CPU architecture, meaning per-core execution speeds trail newer processor generations. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance delivers high thread density and memory capacity suited for distributed general compute rather than latency-sensitive single-threaded operations. In application benchmarks, it demonstrates consistent mid-range execution, achieving 22.12 million operations per second in Redis SET tests, 13.89 GB/sec in static web serving throughput, and moderate throughput during small and medium quantized LLM prompt processing. The primary tradeoffs involve the complete absence of local storage and lower single-thread responsiveness.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is suitable for parallel enterprise applications, including mid-tier database hosting, multi-threaded backend web serving, batch text processing, continuous integration build jobs, and caching tiers where memory footprint and core concurrency are prioritized over cutting-edge single-core speed.

Featuring 128.0 GB of memory, it maintains a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per thread, complemented by a 35 MB L3 cache, AVX-512 support, and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The instance provides no integrated local disk storage and lacks GPU acceleration, directing I/O across network storage services. Performance testing reveals weak single-thread execution, but multi-core throughput stabilizes in the middle tiers, evidenced by a Geekbench multi-core score of 8272.0 and PassMark CPU score of 23181.17. This instance functions effectively for parallelized application workloads, multi-threaded batch jobs, microservice clusters, and in-memory caching tiers.
